newsitem.title: INDIA: CNF's Emery Worldwide sets up in India.
newsitem.headline: CNF's Emery Worldwide sets up in India.

text.p: Consolidated Freightways Transportation Inc subsidiary Emery Worldwide announced on Monday it has formed a wholly owned company in India.
Emery Worldwide India Pte Ltd will provide multi-modal transportation and logistic services through offices in New Delhi, Bombay, Madras, Calcutta and Bangalore.

"This is the third country in Asia this year within which Emery has converted agent operations into wholly owned operating units," Cyril Rodrigo, Emery's vice president, Asia Pacific Area, said in a press release.

New companies have been formed in Taiwan and Korea as part of Emery's ongoing expansion in Asia. The company currently has 30 offices throughout Asia, including China and India, and its regional headquarters in Singapore
Emery has been operating through agents in India since the early 1980s, providing air, ocean, logistics, warehousing and customs brokerage services to customers.
